title: SCA Minhag of the Week 298: "Reciting Hallel in a House of Mourning"

chapters.title: Customs of Hallel in a Beit Abel
Opinions of Chida and Ben Ish Hai
chapters.about: Distinctions between Chanukah and Rosh Chodesh

chapters.title: Kaf HaAhim and Customs in Jerusalem

summary: Joseph Mosseri discusses different customs regarding reciting Hallel in a beit abel on Rosh Chodesh and Chanukah. He cites various sources, including Sidur beit obed, Chida, Ben Ish Hai, and Kaf HaAhim Sofer, and compares the customs of Halab, Jerusalem, and Brooklyn.
questions: Is Hallel recited in a house of mourning on Rosh Chodesh or Chanukah?
What did the Ben Ish Hai say about reciting Hallel in a beit abel?
What was the custom in Halab regarding Hallel in a beit abel?
What do people in Brooklyn do regarding Hallel in a beit abel on Rosh Chodesh?
